title: Fuse Round2 native packed state
objective: Reduce the remaining vector010 Round-2 direct-reference gap using a general exact packed FLINT-owned state across cycle stages, preserving forced exact fallbacks and differential/lifecycle evidence

oracles: forced exact generic FLINT tensor transform
exceptions: Extend the existing audited FLINT/GMP packed order representation primitive only; no fixture-specific branch

handoff.summary: Implemented a general exact terminal-p=2 packed state with adaptive precision retries, bit-sliced modulo-four tensor state, packed GF(2) radical and multiplier kernels, and an immutable prime-boundary restart. Vector010 Round2 is 69.673ms versus PARI's 37ms (1.883x, below the no-case-above-2x gate), down from 233.145ms. Vector429 is 0.650s, down from 6.129s. Vector010 agrees byte-for-byte with the forced exact tensor implementation, vector429 matches its frozen forced-exact hash, 32 randomized differentials agree, and ASan/UBSan passes.
risks: The packed path is intentionally terminal-prime and degree-at-most-64; nonterminal primes and larger degrees keep the exact FLINT tensor fallback.
Linux x64 sanitizer and lifecycle execution passed. The final integration platform matrix must exercise native Windows x64, Linux arm64, and macOS arm64 before release.
next_steps: Integration lane: refresh packages/flint/include/sagejs/number_field_order_ffi.h in architecture/native-audit.json from 1639 lines/68585 bytes to 2344 lines/97540 bytes and extend the rationale with adaptive p-adic tensor state and packed GF(2) kernels.
Integration lane: run pnpm architecture:check after the audit refresh.
Integration lane: preserve bench/results/number-field-round2-native-state-2026-08-18.json as the direct-ratio receipt and rerun the final four-platform native lifecycle suite.
